workload.note: Kokoro plbert is non-autoregressive; a 'decode step' is a full traced T-position re-encode + reconstruction readout + on-device argmax. Numbers are warmed traced replay, min-of-3, (1,4) p300c ring mesh.

ttft_note: eager prefill_forward @128 host-visible first output; production first-token path is the traced token-out (T128 below).
device_e2e_note: For traced nonblocking replay the host issues one execute_trace + one synchronize per step; there is no per-op host dispatch and no per-step host token/position/page-table refresh (bidirectional encoder has no AR feedback loop), so wall-clock e2e == device time. Steady-state host-refresh counters are 0 (host_argmax=0, logits_readbacks=0 on the greedy path).
roofline_method: Modeled weight-read roofline: ~47 MB/device BFP8 linear-weight reads per 12-layer encode (FFN replicated + attention fractured) / ~512 GB/s per-device DRAM BW (from the FFN matmul row saturating 142 GB/s at 27.8% DRAM util). This is NOT the binding constraint.
binding_constraint: op dispatch / kernel launch. tt-perf-report shows only 5.3% aggregate DRAM utilization and ~1 us op-to-op gap across ~200 device ops; this 82M encoder is built from many small ops (12 tied layers, tiny M), so it legitimately sits far below the DRAM roofline. The roofline gap is launch-bound, not an untraced-loop / host-readback / input-refresh defect (those are all zero on the measured path).

before_after.harness: doc/optimized_full_model/perf_full_model.py (min-of-3, ITERS=50), same mesh/session for decoder-only lower bound and full token-out

layer_stack_lower_bound.method: Kokoro has ONE layer kind (weight-tied AlbertLayer x12). The stage-04 optimized multichip decoder's traced 12-layer decode IS the layer-stack lower bound directly (decoder_only_ms above), measured in the same session as the full token-out.
layer_stack_lower_bound.verdict: Full-model token-out overhead over the decoder-layer-stack lower bound is 2.4% @T128 / 6.6% @T512, both within the 10-15% target. Stage-05 was 7.8%/18.3% (T512 above threshold); the stage-06 terminal fixes closed it.

terminal_op_breakdown_reduced_probe_T128.dominant_op_after: MatmulDeviceOperation 32.52% (decoder FFN/attention, stage-04 selected BFP8/HiFi2 policy, preserved verbatim)

named_limitations: 82M encoder is launch/dispatch-bound (5.3% DRAM util); the roofline gap is inherent to a many-small-op tied-layer encoder, not an avoidable host boundary.

ttnn.argmax over a TILE input is single-core; the ROW_MAJOR multi-core path (used here) still costs 36 us @T128 / ~148 us @T512 because it reduces vocab for every sequence position (needed for the bidirectional per-position reconstruction / prefill-check / free-running paths). A last-position-only argmax is not applicable to this all-positions reconstruction contract.

decoder matmul rows are still tagged SLOW / DRAM-bound by tt-perf-report; that is the stage-04 selected geometry/dtype policy (with its rejection ledger) and is preserved verbatim per the optimized-full-model contract (decoder not re-tuned here).
